offers_products.reason: Sells life insurance, preneed funeral and cemetery products, and mortgage loans; caskets and cemetery plots are sold too.

offers_services.reason: Insurance, funeral services and mortgage lending are all services; mortgage origination is the largest segment by volume.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Families buy life insurance, funeral and cemetery services, and home mortgage loans.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Commercial Capital offers bridge loans to mortgage bankers and investors, but this is a minor part.

recurring_revenue.reason: Mortgage origination fees and one-time funeral sales likely exceed insurance premiums; each loan or funeral is a single transaction.

cyclical_demand.reason: Larger mortgage segment depends on home purchases and interest rates, which fall in downturns; insurance and funerals are steadier.

big_ticket.reason: Home mortgage loans are large, infrequent transactions; funerals and whole-life policies are also infrequent purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Revenue comes from insurance underwriting, loan origination and funeral facilities, which rely on balance sheet and assets more than staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are households buying mortgages, insurance and funerals; no large enterprise or government focus.

asset_heavy.reason: Mortgage and insurance are financial businesses; funeral homes and cemeteries own some property, but capital needs are not heavy.

notes: Mortgage segment is judged the largest; revenue mix across the three segments is not stated on the site.
